local_extractor_branch.basis: at least one target/binary state has no fold-specific admitted report-only calls across the existing deterministic and learned sources

limitations: The 58 gold studies are a small study-level cohort; no reliable patient grouping key was available.
No qualified clinical reviewer adjudicated report/reference disagreements.
Confidence intervals do not account for multiple target/state policy fits or the prior adaptive use of these development folds.
Report-only call coverage does not establish image readiness or measured training benefit.
The existing Ticket 17 fold-0 run used its original deterministic admission policy, not this new cross-fit policy.

policy.admission_rule: admit a positive or negative state for a target and consuming fold only when its training-side Wilson lower bound for precision is strictly greater than the training-side prevalence of the called class; otherwise reject that state

confidence_interval.success: a binary report call equals its frozen reference label
